name: Eltel AB (publ)
summary: Eltel AB (publ) operates as an infrastructure and service provider for critical communication and power networks in Finland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Lithuania, Germany, and Poland. The company designs, builds, maintains, and upgrades power distribution and transmission infrastructure, including turnkey high-voltage projects and network construction; and provides turnkey solutions for smart grids, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, wind farms and solar parks, battery energy storage systems, and data centers.
